vocabulary.definition: humorous images, videos, pieces of text, etc., that are copied often with slight variations and spread rapidly by internet users
vocabulary.example: The internet is full of hilarious memes that make people laugh.

vocabulary.definition: circulated rapidly and widely from one internet user to another
vocabulary.example: The video of the cat playing the piano went viral on social media.

vocabulary.definition: a character encoding standard for electronic communication
vocabulary.example: The text art of a cat made using ASCII characters was very creative.

vocabulary.definition: the gradual development of something into a more complex or better form
vocabulary.example: The evolution of technology has made communication easier.

vocabulary.definition: creations of the mind, such as inventions, literary and artistic works, designs, symbols, names, and images used in commerce
vocabulary.example: Companies often protect their intellectual property with patents and trademarks.

vocabulary.definition: the act of promoting a product, service, or event in order to attract or increase interest in it
vocabulary.example: The creative advertising campaign increased sales for the company.
